changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [utility].[GetFormattedFieldLinkValue] ( @Value nvarchar(max) ) RETURNS nvarchar(max) AS BEGIN declare @formattedValue nvarchar(max); declare @linkName nvarchar(max), @linkUrl nvarchar(max) if charindex('|', @Value, 1) > 1 begin SELECT @linkName = TRIM(SUBSTRING(@Value, 1, PATINDEX('%|%', @Value)-1)) SELECT @linkUrl = TRIM(SUBSTRING(@Value, PATINDEX('%|%', @Value)+1, LEN(@Value))) set @formattedValue = '' + @linkName + '' end else begin if @Value <> '' AND @Value <> '|' AND @Value IS NOT NULL begin if LEFT(@Value, 1) = '|' begin set @formattedValue = '' + SUBSTRING(@Value,2, LEN(@Value)) + '' end else begin set @formattedValue = '' + @Value + '' end end else begin set @formattedValue = null end end return @formattedValue end
